about: Retrieval eval for the chat data dictionary (backend/app/services/dictionary.py). Each case lists the dictionary entries the prompt MUST contain to answer the question: 'table' = table-level entry, 'table.column' = column entry. style: direct = uses our own words; paraphrase = how people actually ask, without the synonyms. Run: backend/scripts/eval_dictionary_retrieval.py
